Jack St. Ivany joined from WPG on Oct 25.

story.head: Unstoppable force vs. Immovable object
paras: The Capitals have won three straight, while the Wild (9-3-3) lost 4-3 in overtime to the Islanders on Thursday. Going in, the Wild are first in the Central (second in the NHL) and the Capitals third in the Metropolitan (tied for 13th).
The Wild’s record (.700) is about what their chances are worth. The Capitals’ record (.667) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.575), largely thanks to their goaltending.

The Wild leave the shooting to their forwards (3rd lowest), let the point shots come and guard the net (3rd) and get pinned in their own end on long shifts (31st). Minnesota has allowed 2.33 goals a game, the third fewest in the league. On the other side, the Capitals have had some of the league’s best goaltending (3rd), but have a leaky penalty kill (27th). They also get the league’s best looks (1st), so their good looks will be harder to come by against the Wild. The Wild are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Caps.

Kirill Kaprizov (14 G / 10 A / 24 P in 15 GP) leads the Wild in scoring and is tied for second in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games. Quinn Hughes (4 G / 16 A / 20 P in 15 GP) is next in line, with seven points in his last five games and a point in six straight games against Washington. Alex Tuch (10 G / 2 A / 12 P in 12 GP) is tied for the Capitals’ scoring lead. Dylan Strome (3 G / 9 A / 12 P in 12 GP) shares it, with seven points in his last five games.
Jesper Wallstedt (8-2-3 / .916 SV% in 13 GS) has been terrific for Minnesota and will likely start. Logan Thompson (5-3-0 / .903 SV% in 8 GS) is in line to start for Washington.
At home, Spencer Carbery likes to send Protas, Dubois and Wilson out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy.

items.text: Kirill Kaprizov is one point from 500.

The Wild are newly without Jared Spurgeon and Joel Eriksson Ek, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Kings are missing more right now.
The Capitals have been without Rasmus Sandin for several games.
Jordan Kyrou has eight goals in eleven games against Minnesota since 2023-24, most of them with St. Louis.
